parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD. Fuzzy match filtering is supported.

parameters.name: DomainSearchType
parameters.description:
The domain name query type. Valid values:

- **fuzzy_match** (default): fuzzy match.
- **pre_match**: prefix match.
- **suf_match**: suffix match.
- **full_match**: exact match.

parameters.name: DomainStatus
parameters.description:
The domain name status filter. Valid values:

- **online**: Enabled.
- **offline**: Disabled.
- **configuring**: Being configured.
- **configure_failed**: Configuration failed.
- **checking**: Being reviewed.
- **check_failed**: Review failed.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**. Maximum value: **50**. Valid values: any integer from **1** to **50**.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

By default, all tag keys are queried.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

By default, all tag values are queried.
